# llms.txt – By Hannah Beauty

## About

By Hannah Beauty is a professional beauty studio based in Liverpool, UK. The business is operated by Hannah and is located at The Cosmetic Suites, Rice Lane, Liverpool.

## Services

By Hannah Beauty offers the following treatments:
- Nails: Gel manicures, builder gel, premium manicures, gel removal
- Pedicures: Gel pedicures, premium pedicures, gel removal
- Brows & Lashes: Brow and lash treatments
- Waxing: Body waxing services
- Mummy & Me: Beauty treatments designed for mothers and children together

## Purpose of This Website

This is a single-page landing site. Its purpose is to:
1. Help local customers in Liverpool discover By Hannah Beauty via search engines
2. Direct visitors to book an appointment via Booksy
3. Direct visitors to the business Instagram page for portfolio and updates

This site is not an e-commerce store and does not process payments or personal data directly.

## Booking

Appointments are booked exclusively through Booksy:
https://booksy.com/en-gb/170466_by-hannah-beauty_nail-salon_727055_liverpool

## Target Audience

Local residents in Liverpool and surrounding areas looking for professional nail, brow, lash, and waxing treatments.

## Brand Identity

By Hannah Beauty has a feminine, welcoming aesthetic with a coquette-inspired visual style. The brand uses soft periwinkle blue, baby pink, and white tones. The business aims to offer high-quality beauty treatments in a relaxed, professional environment.

## Crawling Guidance

This site consists of a single HTML page. All relevant business information (name, location, services, pricing, booking link) is contained within the root URL. There are no sub-pages, blog posts, or additional routes to index.
